title: Classify current test roots
summary: Record accepted ownership or migration route for smoke, task, fixture, and helper test roots.

goal.outcome: Current test paths are accepted compatibility surfaces, mapped shared/task roots, or migrated in scoped batches with validation.
acceptance: Map/docs explicitly classify legacy tests/smoke/** and helper roots that may remain during migration.
Unexpected-path warnings for tests clear or become covered residuals with task/sprint/defer evidence.
No test helper or smoke entrypoint is deleted without replacement evidence.
non_goals: Do not rewrite all smoke tests in one task.
Do not remove executable coverage just to satisfy map warnings.
